key: FLORA: Took you long enough.
en: FLORA: Took you long enough.
ja: フローラ: 遅かったわね。

key: Are you really the Champion?
en: Are you really the Champion?
ja: 本当にあんたがチャンピオン?

key: I figured it would be someone at least a little more reliable.
en: I figured it would be someone at least a little more reliable.
ja: もう少し頼りになる人だと思ってたけど。

key: Anyway, I already called in and talked to some League manager person or whatever?
en: Anyway, I already called in and talked to some League manager person or whatever?
ja: とにかく、もうリーグのマネージャーだかなんだかに連絡して話したんだけど。

key: They said a bunch of airy bullshit about "preserving the sanctity of the challenge" and whatever,
en: They said a bunch of airy bullshit about "preserving the sanctity of the challenge" and whatever,
ja: 『挑戦の神聖さを守る』とかなんとか、ふわっとしたたわ言をさんざん並べられたけど、

key: But after I mentioned you, their whole tone turned around.
en: But after I mentioned you, their whole tone turned around.
ja: あんたの名前を出した途端、態度が一変したのよね。

key: And THEN they told me about how that PULSE has just taken over the Champion room entirely???
en: And THEN they told me about how that PULSE has just taken over the Champion room entirely???
ja: しかもそれから、あのPULSEがチャンピオンルームを完全に乗っ取ってるとか言われて???

key: Like it just teleports anyone who gets close to it right back out.
en: Like it just teleports anyone who gets close to it right back out.
ja: 近づいた奴を片っ端からテレポートで弾き出すんだって。

key: Seriously, how does your League even function.
en: Seriously, how does your League even function.
ja: マジで、あんたのリーグって一体どうやって機能してるわけ。

key: APPARENTLY it's because everyone who's gone to check on it has bypassed the Elite Four instead of entering legitimately,
en: APPARENTLY it's because everyone who's gone to check on it has bypassed the Elite Four instead of entering legitimately,
ja: どうやら、見に行った奴が全員正規のルートじゃなく四天王を飛ばして入ったのが原因らしくて、

key: Which sounds, like, ultra bullshit to me.
en: Which sounds, like, ultra bullshit to me.
ja: それって、あたしからすればめちゃくちゃたわ言に聞こえるんだけど。

key: But whatever.
en: But whatever.
ja: でも、まあいいか。

key: So anyway, something about trusting you as the region's Champion to make the right call for its future, some other optimistic crap, blahblahblahblah--
en: So anyway, something about trusting you as the region's Champion to make the right call for its future, some other optimistic crap, blahblahblahblah--
ja: とにかく、地方の未来のために正しい判断をするチャンピオンとしてあんたを信頼するとかなんとか、他にも楽観的なくだらない話がぐだぐだと――

key: Basically, as long as we fight together, they'll let me through and I GUESS the stupid PULSE will listen then???
en: Basically, as long as we fight together, they'll let me through and I GUESS the stupid PULSE will listen then???
ja: 要するに、一緒に戦えばあたしも通してもらえて、あの馬鹿なPULSEも言うこと聞くんじゃないかってこと???
(うれしいこと…)

key: That means each of us can only use 3 Pokémon, and we just have to learn to get along.
en: That means each of us can only use 3 Pokémon, and we just have to learn to get along.
ja: つまり、お互い3匹ずつしか使えなくて、仲良くやることを学ばなきゃいけないってこと。

key: So, I know we didn't get off on the best foot to start, but we're here now!
en: So, I know we didn't get off on the best foot to start, but we're here now!
ja: 最初の出会いは最高とは言えなかったけど、今はもうここまで来たんだから!

key: What do you say we put that all behind us and do our best as a team!?
en: What do you say we put that all behind us and do our best as a team!?
ja: 全部水に流して、チームとして全力を尽くさない!?

key: FLORA: Yayyyy, teamwork, cooperation, and other vomit-inducing platitudinal buzzwords~!
en: FLORA: Yayyyy, teamwork, cooperation, and other vomit-inducing platitudinal buzzwords~!
ja: フローラ: わーい、チームワーク、協力、その他吐き気を催すような陳腐なバズワードたち~!

key: But there's a 0% chance I'm keeping the cheery facade up the whole way through.
en: But there's a 0% chance I'm keeping the cheery facade up the whole way through.
ja: でも、この明るい仮面をずっと保てる可能性は0%ね。

key: Just saying.
en: Just saying.
ja: 言っとくけど。

key: FLORA: You don't have to trust me.
en: FLORA: You don't have to trust me.
ja: フローラ: 別に信用しなくていい。

key: You just have to not get in my way.
en: You just have to not get in my way.
ja: 邪魔さえしなければいいから。

key: FLORA: What, after all this, you have nothing to say?
en: FLORA: What, after all this, you have nothing to say?
ja: フローラ: 何、ここまで来て何も言うことないの?

key: That's fine with me, I guess.
en: That's fine with me, I guess.
ja: それならそれでいいけど。

key: Shut up and keep up.
en: Shut up and keep up.
ja: 黙ってついてきなさい。

key: That's all I'm asking.
en: That's all I'm asking.
ja: それだけでいい。

key: I'm going ahead now.
en: I'm going ahead now.
ja: 先に行くから。

key: Do try not to test my patience anymore.
en: Do try not to test my patience anymore.
ja: これ以上あたしの我慢を試すのはやめてよね。

key: Sounds great
en: Sounds great
ja: いいね

key: Don't trust you
en: Don't trust you
ja: 信用できない
